notes.title: Dragon Kingdom War Soundtracks are now available for sale!
notes.content:
An original soundtrack by Jobbe 3.14 Soundescign created for Dragon Kingdom War.
Great when you want to relax in a magical kingdom of RPG.
Files are in high quality MP3 format.

1. Destiny (2.08)
2. Black Dragon (2.07)
3. Bounty Hunter (2:12)
4. Dark Eyes (2:02)
5. Freedom (1:06)
6. No Fear (2:00)
7. In My Dreams (1:44)
8. Lost World (2:05)
9. Miracle (2:04)
10. Turmoil (1:58)
11. Victory Jingle (0:09)
12. Lose Jingle (0:08)
